question: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.

-- Final comprehensive seller performance report
WITH order_review_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        AVG(review_score) as avg_review_score
    FROM order_reviews
    GROUP BY order_id
),
order_packing AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CAST(order_delivered_carrier_date AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP))) / 86400.0 as packing_days
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL 
      AND order_approved_at IS NOT NULL
),
seller_item_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_quantity,
        SUM(oi.price) as total_sales,
        AVG(oi.price) as avg_item_price
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
seller_review_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(ora.avg_review_score) as avg_review_score
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN order_review_avg ora ON oi.order_id = ora.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_packing_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(op.packing_days) as avg_packing_days
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN order_packing op ON oi.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        pcat.product_category_name_english,
        SUM(oi.price) as category_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC) as rn
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pcat ON p.product_category_name = pcat.product_category_name
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, pcat.product_category_name_english
)
SELECT 
    sim.seller_id,
    s.seller_city,
    s.seller_state,
    sim.total_quantity,
    ROUND(sim.total_sales, 2) as total_sales,
    ROUND(sim.avg_item_price, 2) as avg_item_price,
    ROUND(COALESCE(srm.avg_review_score, 0), 2) as avg_review_score,
    ROUND(COALESCE(spm.avg_packing_days, 0), 2) as avg_packing_days,
    cs.product_category_name_english as top_category
FROM seller_item_metrics sim
JOIN sellers s ON sim.seller_id = s.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_review_metrics srm ON sim.seller_id = srm.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_packing_metrics spm ON sim.seller_id = spm.seller_id
LEFT JOIN category_sales cs ON sim.seller_id = cs.seller_id AND cs.rn = 1
ORDER BY sim.total_sales DESC
